system.summary: Depending on the demon: either low-light vision or sight in total darkness, as chosen by the GM.
system.description:
The demon's exact nature is decided by the GM. Some demons see by weak light as if it were daylight; others see in total darkness.

Choose Low-Light Vision or Darkvision as appropriate to that demon. The two possibilities are not automatically cumulative, and this entry does not give every demon both types of vision.
